Makes 1 serve

1/2 teaspoon of olive oil

1 shallot, finely diced

7oz carrots

2 cups of chicken stock

1/2 to 2 teaspoons of Morrocan spice mix (I'm using Ras el Hanout)

2 tbspns roughly chopped coriander leaves

sea salt and pepper to taste

1 tbspn greek yogurt

Sauté shallot in olive oil over medium heat for 2-3 minutes. Add carrots and Ras El Hanout and stir for one minute.

Add stock and reduce to a simmer for 10-15 minutes, until carrots are very tender, then stir in fresh coriander leaves.

Puree using a stick blender, season to taste and stir through yoghurt to serve.
